models_evaluated: Artificial Intelligence Clinical Assistant Decision Support System (AI-CDSS)
unlisted_practices: AI clinical decision support for VTE risk assessment and thromboprophylaxis prompting in hospitalised patients, evaluated in a randomised trial

screen.reason: This is a prospective randomized controlled trial evaluating the deployment of an AI clinical decision support system (AI-CDSS) versus usual care for VTE prevention. It evaluates the impact of deploying the AI tool itself rather than testing a specific implementation safeguard or deployment practice.
